description:
Find coordinates for an address or place name (OpenStreetMap Nominatim).

        Check `geospark.warnings` for ambiguous names (e.g. "Springfield") and ask the user
        which one they mean, or add a region.
name: geocode

outputSchema.description: An RFC 7946 GeoJSON FeatureCollection; `geospark` holds status, units, warnings, provenance.
outputSchema.title: FeatureCollection

title: Geocode a place
